notes: Boot elvis (5.00) with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, built-in mechanisms off. Walk the Portals service menu with the Black ENTER (public 0), Green RIGHT (public -1) and Red LEFT (public -2) buttons: Portals, MAIN MENU (DIAG), DIAGNOSTICS MENU, eleven steps right through COIL, LAMP, FLASH, CLR, TECH, PLAY, KNOCKER, SPKR, BURN and DOT TEST to ELVIS, and enter the ELVIS test (STEPPER MOTOR TEST), whose cursor starts on RUN. Press RUN twice, 20 s apart; move to PULSE and pulse three times; move to LEGS and press once; move to ARMS and press once. The scenario never writes 33: LibPinMAME's elvis.c writes it from its own count of the stepper phases (1 at its home count 0), so every level of 33 in this run is the emulator's, not the ROM's or the host's.
